module.name: Cert-Manager (Jetstack)
module.description: Deploys Jetstack cert-manager v1.16.1 for automatic certificate management. Per F5 BNK 2.2 GA docs: 'F5 tested BIG-IP Next for Kubernetes with Jetstack Cert Manager v1.16.1'. Creates self-signed ClusterIssuer for BNK component certificates.

required.name: cluster_name
required.description: Name of the Kubernetes cluster (used for resource identification)

optional.name: cert_manager_version
optional.description: Jetstack cert-manager version. F5 BNK 2.2 GA tested with v1.16.1

optional.name: create_cluster_issuer
optional.description: Create self-signed ClusterIssuer for BNK certificates

optional.name: cluster_issuer_name
optional.description: Name of the CA ClusterIssuer (referenced by FLO global.certmgr.clusterIssuer)

optional.name: create_namespace
optional.description: Whether to create the cert-manager namespace

key_outputs.name: cert_manager_ready
key_outputs.description: Flag indicating cert-manager is deployed and ready

key_outputs.name: cluster_issuer_name
key_outputs.description: Name of the ClusterIssuer for FLO and CNEInstance configuration

key_outputs.name: release_status
key_outputs.description: Status of the Helm release deployment
